applies_to: Each of five logical innovation routes; actual concurrent execution remains resource-limited.

field_definitions.question_zh: 强基线在哪个必要条件下失败，该失败为何影响原 proposal？
evidence: downstream consequence or explicitly untested consequence

field_definitions.question_zh: 修改何对象、用何允许信息、通过何机制改善何输出，何时应无效？
最近 3–5 个近邻工作的机制与本候选有何差别？
field_definitions.warning: Search not finding a duplicate does not establish firstness; never invent 3-5 citations to satisfy a count.

field_definitions.question_zh: 去掉新部件退化成什么，何种简单替代解释可能同样有效？
evidence: simple competing explanation or matched null control

field_definitions.question_zh: 推理信息在当时是否可得，是否使用 GT、未来帧或测试标签？
哪个最低成本干预可以区分本机制与替代解释？
基线、预算和精度适配是否公平，是否保留所有冻结条件及失败？
evidence: all frozen outcomes including failures and nulls

field_definitions.question_zh: 结果支持、否定或尚不能判定什么，下一步为何值得做？
本地先执行什么，如何接回几何相关指标和生成消费者？
如何避免在已见场景上选条件并把它当盲测？

gate_order.name: Observed problem and hypothesis
gate_order.advance_if: Real condition and important failure are identified, or an explicit plan will test whether the hypothesized failure exists.
gate_order.cannot_claim: A residual by itself proves memory failure or generated-video degradation.

gate_order.name: Prior-art and fatal-flaw audit
gate_order.advance_if: Mechanism difference is precise and no unrepairable flaw, known direct duplicate, or current data-refuted premise invalidates this version.
gate_order.cannot_claim: A favorable self-score proves novelty or top-venue quality.

gate_order.name: Frozen minimal discriminating experiment
gate_order.advance_if: Inputs, comparison, control, metric, decision and stop conditions are committed before new test execution.
gate_order.cannot_claim: Previously inspected TUM results are blinded confirmation.

gate_order.name: Real mechanism evidence
gate_order.advance_if: Actual runs distinguish the proposed mechanism from key simpler explanations with transparent costs, nulls, and scope.
gate_order.cannot_claim: A local geometry gain equals full generative-system improvement.

gate_order.name: Generalization and proposal integration
gate_order.advance_if: Claim-matched independent conditions and the relevant generation consumer confirm utility, with strongest nearby baselines and complete evidence.
gate_order.cannot_claim: Internal gate passage guarantees external acceptance or an advisor response.

decision_rules.fatal_flaw_rule: Use evidence and repairability, not the contradictory upstream automatic MAJOR-count rule.
decision_rules.untested_rule: An untested but coherent candidate may proceed to a low-cost falsifier; untested does not mean disproven.
decision_rules.rejected_rule: Do not revive a rejected mechanism by renaming it. A materially changed premise requires an explicit version and new test.
decision_rules.replication_rule: Repeat where randomness, sampling, or relevant noise can affect conclusions; do not mechanically repeat deterministic runs.
decision_rules.failure_rule: Preserve failed runs and missing/null data; never relabel synthetic or oracle results as real deployable improvement.
decision_rules.permissions_rule: The user authorized local research. Do not add approval gates inferred from vague skill wording; do not claim personal user comprehension, hours, or endorsement.
